documents.body: Lighthouse deploys through the blue-green pipeline. Promote with `make promote ENV=prod` after the canary holds for 15 minutes. Rollback: `make rollback ENV=prod` restores the previous slot. The health endpoint is /healthz and must return 200 before promotion.

Every Lighthouse release needs a signed changelog entry, a green e2e suite and an approval from the security reviewer. Tags follow vYYYY.MM.patch. Release notes are drafted in docs/releases and published on Thursday.

Pebble is published to the package registry from CI only. The publish token lives in the CI secret store under PEBBLE_PUBLISH; local publishing is disabled because the registry enforces two-factor auth. Bump the version with `pebble release minor`.
Pebble crashes on Windows paths longer than 260 characters; workaround: enable long paths. The progress bar flickers in tmux when TERM is screen; set TERM=tmux-256color.

Always target tmux sessions with an exact match: `tmux kill-session -t =build`. Without the = prefix tmux prefix-matches and can kill build-cache instead. Avoid session names that are prefixes of other sessions.
Backups run nightly with restic to the object storage bucket nightly-archive. Verify weekly with `restic check`. Photos are excluded because they already sync to the photo service.
The office network is reached through the mesh VPN. The build server answers at 10.20.0.14; SSH user is ci. The key is stored in the system keychain entry build-ssh.
Use the monospace font Iosevka at 14pt. Format on save is enabled for TypeScript and Python; Python uses ruff.
Dana wants weekly status updates on Friday with the release date first and timestamps in UTC. She prefers a table over long prose.
Dana is a data engineer who maintains the ingestion jobs. She is not the team lead; route approvals to Minho.
Minho owns the payments service and reviews every schema migration. He prefers written RFCs over meetings.
Batch summarization jobs run on the small model; code review and release gates run on the large model. Revisit at the quarterly budget review.
A maintainer merges a pull request once CI is green and one reviewer approved the latest commit. Stacked PRs: retarget children to main before deleting the parent branch.
Promotion limits: at most two promotion posts per network per week, on the blog and the community forum. Send a plain-text weekly report on Sunday.
The CDN cache served stale bundles for two hours after the Lighthouse deploy because the purge job used the old distribution id. Fix: purge by tag instead of id.
A DNS record for the status page expired; renewal is now automated with a 30-day reminder.
Spent the week on the onboarding flow. Session replay showed users dropping at the pricing step.
Reviewed analytics dashboards and cleaned up old sessions and branches.
The garden planner stores plant schedules locally and syncs through the sync service every six hours. Push notifications remind users to water.
The newsletter is written in markdown, rendered with the static site generator and sent every Monday at 07:00 KST.
라이트하우스 배포는 블루그린 파이프라인으로 진행한다. 카나리를 15분 유지한 뒤 프로덕션으로 승격한다. 문제가 생기면 롤백 명령으로 이전 슬롯을 복구한다.
회의 녹음은 로컬 받아쓰기 엔진으로 텍스트로 변환한다. 모델 파일은 medium 크기를 쓰고, 44kHz 스테레오 녹음을 16kHz 모노 wav로 먼저 변환한다.
모든 답변 끝에 팀 이름과 작성 날짜를 짧게 표시한다. 형식은 괄호 안에 두 값을 넣는다.
사내 리눅스 서버는 메시 VPN으로 접속한다. 재부팅 후 SSH 서버가 자동으로 켜지도록 서비스로 등록했다. 메모리 상한은 4GB로 설정했다.
블로그 글 제목은 40자 이내로 쓴다. 코드 예제는 실행 가능한 것만 넣는다. 이미지 첨부가 되는 게시판에는 구성도를 넣는다.
디스크 용량이 커진 원인은 오래된 컨테이너 이미지 캐시였다. 오래된 이미지를 목록으로 뽑아 검증한 뒤 삭제했다.
클라우드 빌드 크레딧이 떨어지면 야간 빌드를 멈추고 수동 빌드만 돌린다. 충전은 팀장이 한다.
매주 월요일 아홉 시에 스프린트 보드를 보고 이번 주 할 일을 캘린더에 올린다. 다른 팀의 일은 올리지 않는다.
Shared credentials live in the team vault; personal tokens live in the OS keychain. Never paste secrets into chat or notes.
Uptime checks run every minute; alerts page the on-call phone. Dashboards live in the metrics UI under the ops folder.
出張の経費は月末までに精算システムで申請する。領収書は写真で添付し、原本は三か月保管する。
本番サーバーの秘密鍵は保管庫にだけ置く。鍵の更新は半年ごとに行い、古い鍵はすぐに無効化する。
会議室は社内カレンダーから予約する。十名以上の会議は大会議室を使い、前日までに予約を確定する。
移动应用每两周发布一次。发布前需要完成回归测试，并由产品负责人签字确认。版本号采用年份加周数。
生产数据库每天凌晨三点全量备份，备份文件保留三十天。恢复演练每季度进行一次。
值班每周轮换一次，交接在周一上午完成。紧急告警必须在十五分钟内响应。
